classes/arboreal-guardian-522.name: Bond's Call
classes/arboreal-guardian-522.description: At 1st level, once per round determine the direction to the bonded spirit tree with the source's DC 15 direction check; under the Ghostwalk 3.5 skill update this uses Survival.

classes/arboreal-guardian-522.name: Forestwalk
classes/arboreal-guardian-522.description: At 1st level, while within the Spirit Wood, increase land speed by 10 feet; this bonus stacks with other speed bonuses.

classes/arboreal-guardian-522.name: Nature's Water
classes/arboreal-guardian-522.description: At 2nd level, acquire potions from the bonded spirit tree for their creation cost when the necessary herbs and ingredients are supplied.

classes/arboreal-guardian-522.name: Natural Armor
classes/arboreal-guardian-522.description: Beginning at 2nd level, gain an enhancement bonus to the character's existing natural armor bonus. The enhancement is +1 at 2nd, +2 at 4th, +3 at 6th, +4 at 8th, and +5 at 10th level, using the official Ghostwalk 3.5 correction.

classes/arboreal-guardian-522.name: Unhindered Charge
classes/arboreal-guardian-522.description: At 3rd level, when charging or taking an action, pass unhindered through normal inanimate living plants, including larger plants such as trees, similarly to woodland stride.

classes/arboreal-guardian-522.name: Wood Speech
classes/arboreal-guardian-522.description: At 3rd level, telepathically communicate with the bonded spirit tree or any of its other Arboreal Guardians at a range of 1 mile.

classes/arboreal-guardian-522.name: Hunter's Mercy
classes/arboreal-guardian-522.description: At 5th level, once per day as a standard action, focus so the first successful bow attack in the next round is automatically a critical hit; activation does not provoke an attack of opportunity.

classes/arboreal-guardian-522.name: Blindsight
classes/arboreal-guardian-522.description: At 5th level, once per day as a free action gain blindsight out to 30 feet for a number of rounds equal to Arboreal Guardian class level.

classes/arboreal-guardian-522.name: Nature's Defender
classes/arboreal-guardian-522.description: At 7th level, while within 500 feet of the bonded spirit tree, gain a +1 morale bonus on attack rolls, weapon damage, checks, and saving throws.

classes/arboreal-guardian-522.name: Quench
classes/arboreal-guardian-522.description: At 7th level use quench as the spell once per day.

classes/arboreal-guardian-522.name: Tree Stride
classes/arboreal-guardian-522.description: At 9th level use tree stride as the spell once per day.
